calculation.expression: -sum(return, 3) when lagged VIX daily change exceeds its trailing 60-day 75th percentile; cross-sectionally demean
calculation.description: At each date, identify a volatility shock using only the prior completed day's VIX change and trailing history. During shock dates, rank assets by negative trailing three-day return, favoring short-term rebound candidates; inactive dates have missing signals. VIX is observation-only and no orders are placed on it.

validation.regime_notes: Daily gate passes over 107 active dates, but early 2020-2022 IC is negative (-0.0362) while 2023 onward is positive (0.0933 in 2023-2024, 0.0824 in 2025-2026, 0.1138 in 2027 through February 25). Small active-date sample and regime dependence require conservative use and rolling revalidation.
